input_monitoring.title: Input Monitoring Permission Required
input_monitoring.description:
BongoCat needs Input Monitoring permission to receive keyboard and mouse input.

Note: if BongoCat is already in the list, select it and click "−" to remove it, then click "+" to add it again. Restart BongoCat after granting the permission.

administrator.title: Run as Administrator Recommended
administrator.description:
BongoCat needs to run as administrator to keep receiving keyboard and mouse input while other windows are in the foreground.

To set it up: right-click BongoCat → Properties → Compatibility → turn on "Run this program as an administrator".

keep_inside_screen.label: Keep on screen
keep_inside_screen.description: Keep the model window fully on screen, even where it covers the taskbar, Dock or menu bar.

hide_on_pointer_hover.label: Hide on pointer hover
hide_on_pointer_hover.description: Fade the model window out while the pointer rests on it, and restore it when the pointer leaves.

hide_on_pointer_hover_delay.label: Hover hide delay (seconds)
hide_on_pointer_hover_delay.description: Delay before the model window hides while the pointer rests on it, from 0 to 60 seconds; 0 hides it on entry.

scale.label: Window scale
scale.description: Resize the model window from 25% to 400%.

opacity.label: Window opacity
opacity.description: Adjust the model window opacity from 1% to 100%.

corner_radius.label: Window corner radius
corner_radius.description: Round the model window corners from 0% to 50% of its width and height.

maximum_fps.label: Maximum FPS
maximum_fps.description: Limit animation and overlay updates from 15 to 240 FPS.

release_fallback_timeout.label: Key release fallback (milliseconds)
release_fallback_timeout.description: Release a captured key only when normal release and state reconciliation both fail; 0 disables it.

auto_update.label: Check for updates automatically
auto_update.description: Check for updates at startup and every 24 hours.
